mapper.select: SELECT t_gonggao.id, t_gonggao.t_title, t_gonggao.t_content, t_gonggao.t_shijian, t_gonggao.t_bz, t_gonggao.addTime FROM t_gonggao WHERE t_gonggao.id = #{id}

SELECT t_gonggao.id, t_gonggao.t_title, t_gonggao.t_content, t_gonggao.t_shijian, t_gonggao.t_bz, t_gonggao.addTime FROM t_gonggao WHERE 1 = 1
and t_gonggao.t_title like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_gonggao.t_content like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_gonggao.t_shijian like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_gonggao.t_bz like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_gonggao.addTime like '%${fieldValue}%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_gonggao(addTime,t_title, t_content, t_shijian, t_bz) VALUES(#{addTime},#{title}, #{content}, #{shijian}, #{bz})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_gonggao set t_title=#{title}, t_content=#{content}, t_shijian=#{shijian}, t_bz=#{bz} where id=#{id}
